title: A Home for the Office: Thirdway to create new London HQ
description: Thirdway partners with owners, occupiers, and professional teams to create world-class spaces.

main: We are incredibly excited to share a defining moment in our journey: we’ve secured a new headquarters at 224 St John Street, EC1. Working in partnership with Paloma Capital, we will be taking the entire 21,000 sq ft building in the heart of Clerkenwell, London’s historic creative district.

The building will undergo a complete transformation over the next year, and we are thrilled to be delivering the Architecture, Design & Build, Furniture and Technology solutions, as well as taking a position within the building’s ownership structure.

Our ambitious refurbishment will reinstate a context appropriate, materially rich façade and reconfigure the interior from top to bottom. We will apply the full breadth of our creative, technical, sustainability, and delivery know-how to create a workplace that embodies our design philosophy: a home for the office, and a place people ‘get’ to go to, not have to. This is a huge creative and technical challenge, but these are the kinds of challenges that energise us — this is where we do our best work.

The decision to invest in such an ambitious, complex project reflects our ongoing growth and aspiration. From our humble beginnings in a 500 sq ft on St John’s Lane in 2009, to now building a flagship HQ for our 200-strong team, this next chapter places our people right at the centre.
The building is scheduled for completion in Q2 2026.

main.className: max-w-[796px] font-sans text-[24px] leading-[1.2] font-medium tracking-[-0.06em] text-warm-black lg:text-[32px]

main: Taking the entire building to create a headquarters at 224 St John Street gives us the freedom to do something ambitious: to craft a true ‘home for the office’ — a space people ‘get’ to go to. We deliver complex briefs across London, so it feels right to apply that experience to our own space, using our Architecture and Design & Build capabilities end-to-end. It’s a big undertaking, but exactly the kind we’re built for as market leaders.

main: Our decision to invest energy, creativity, and money into this space is a fundamental part of our growth strategy and this will undoubtedly be a platform for our people to do their best work. This office can also help inspire our partners to think about the next generation of office occupiers. We have built trust with London’s leading property experts by delivering time and time again, so I have every confidence in our team’s capability with this complex, exciting challenge.
